build_exponential_moving_average: build a Haiku module to compute an exponential moving average with optional zero debiasing and warmup
create_batch_norm_layer: create a BatchNorm layer that supports optional masking and cross replica axis for distributed training
build_graph_convolution_layer: build a Graph Convolution layer that aggregates node and edge features with optional bidirectional message passing
create_mlp_layer: create a multi-layer perceptron with configurable layers, activation, and optional LayerNorm
build_multi_head_attention: build a multi-head attention module with optional dropout, bias, and complex number support
